channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Week 24 Results: Cup Semi-Finals and League Quarter-Finals
item.description: A week of exciting Cup semi-finals and league quarter-finals with impressive performances and hard-fought matches. Check out the highlights and results!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 22 Results Recap
item.description: Recap of a week of intense badminton matches at Navan Badminton Club, with two teams advancing to the Cup Semi-Finals and reflections on the efforts and outcomes.
